title: Measured gate scans: eight (L)-laws empty, mix3 inhabited free, sign-split family at v_2
statement: Closed-form Gaussian-mixture strip-moment scans (py/ds_stable_basins.py; selftest validates against the public scorequant IntegrationSource tensor Gauss-Legendre quadrature at 1e-9 and exact 8-atom rationals): (1) Gaussian laws at rho in {0, 0.6, 0.9} plus an anisotropic case are rank-one at every tilt on a 241-point grid (max lambda_min <= 2.4e-16), tilt-residual zero-free, Moebius orbits non-convergent; (2) product bimodal (L)-laws (m in {0.75..3}, s = 0.4) and dependent (L)-laws xcorr(c in {0.5, 0.8, 0.95}): branch-tracked root scans over beta in [-2.5, 2.5] tracking up to 3 Lloyd-stationary branches per tilt (asymmetric mode-splitting branches included) find ZERO self-consistent roots - eight (L)-laws, three structural families, zero gate inhabitants, all measured BEFORE the DS17.1 proof was trusted; (3) the N(0,I_2) sign-split family has Phi - 2/pi = 0 to machine precision across the split parameter, lambda_min maximal 1/pi at v = 0, v_3 - v_2 = 0.173206; (4) mix3 has exactly one root: beta = 0, cuts +-1.00476, lambda_min = 1.7364, value = v_3 to 1e-6 (price ~ 0), zero Monte-Carlo rule violations - the population object behind DS16's measured mix3 retention; (5) geometry of the 420 recorded DS16 ascent terminals: the N = 8 margin-retaining witness is companion-EXACT; centered06 terminals are 2% companion-exact (median disagreement 18%, median lambda_min 0.034) vs 61% and 1.06 on mix3 - the DS17.1 class boundary visible in finite states; (6) seeded public-library ascent (N = 300..3000) per rows N-DS-BASINS-LIBRARY.
assumptions: population quantities are closed-form Phi/phi mixture algebra, no sampling; Monte Carlo appears only in violation scans and library runs with deterministic seeds SEED_BASE = 20260831
measured, never theorem authority; scan grids and branch multistarts are finite - absence of roots on a grid is evidence, the proof is DS17.1
full provenance (git revision, script sha256, python, platform) in WORK/artifacts/DS-STABLE-BASINS/
